assumptions.choice: Size is calculated from the signal-bar close, includes the fixed 0.001 commission, and is rounded down to whole shares.
assumptions.reason: The next-bar market fill price is unknown when the entry decision is made; including commission implements the stated requirement that cash remain at least 50% of capital after opening.

assumptions.choice: Capital means current broker equity; the conversion cap uses current position market value at the bar close divided by current broker equity.
assumptions.reason: The specification refers to capital and total position value without defining a separate capital base.

assumptions.choice: The protective stop is submitted after the entry fills at fill price minus 1.5 times the entry-bar ATR, and is cancelled when the position becomes core or is otherwise closed.
assumptions.reason: A stop requires the actual entry execution price; a core is explicitly a holding without a time stop, and the specification describes it as long-term.

assumptions.choice: The 1 ATR profit target uses ATR at entry; the post-entry drawdown conversion test uses the current lower band and current ATR.
assumptions.reason: The target and stop are entry-based price levels, while the conversion condition is evaluated after entry against the then-current indicator values.

assumptions.choice: Active bars are counted from the bar on which the entry order completes; bar 25 is the first 25–27 management bar.
assumptions.reason: A position becomes active only upon execution.

assumptions.choice: A roll closes first and submits the replacement entry after the close order completes.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader market orders execute on a later bar; this preserves the one-position-at-a-time rule while implementing the requested timer reset.

assumptions.choice: Core conversion is evaluated before ordinary profit-taking and time-based exit rules; broker stop orders may execute intrabar before a close-based conversion signal can be evaluated.
assumptions.reason: Conversion is an explicit state change triggered by the close, whereas the protective stop is a standing stop order.
